# Atlas South Technical Services

> Commercial facilities and trades services provider covering London and the South East of England. Atlas South delivers electrical, plumbing, fire safety, and full facilities management for commercial buildings — reactive maintenance and planned service agreements, available 24/7. Commercial and industrial clients only; no residential/domestic work.

Atlas South has delivered 12,000+ jobs across London and the South East since 2018, spanning emergency call-outs through to fully managed facilities contracts.

## Company

- [About](https://atlassouth.co.uk/company): Mission, vision, and company background
- [Contact](https://atlassouth.co.uk/company/contact): Get in touch or request a quote

## Hard Services

- [Electricals](https://atlassouth.co.uk/hard-services/electricals): Commercial electrical installation, testing, and repair
- [Plumbing](https://atlassouth.co.uk/hard-services/plumbing): Commercial plumbing installation and reactive repair
- [Reactive Maintenance](https://atlassouth.co.uk/hard-services/reactive-maintenance): 24/7 emergency call-out and building fabric repairs
- [Fire & Safety](https://atlassouth.co.uk/hard-services/fire-safety): Fire safety systems, testing, and compliance

## Soft Services

- [Facilities Management](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/facilities-management): Fully managed building services contracts
- [Security Services](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/security): Manned guarding and site security
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/commercial-cleaning): Scheduled and one-off commercial cleaning
- [Catering](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/catering): Commercial catering services
- [Aviation Services](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/aviation): Facilities services for aviation sites
- [Concierge](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/concierge): Front-of-house and concierge services
- [Waste & Recycling](https://atlassouth.co.uk/soft-services/waste-recycling): Commercial waste management and recycling

## Industries Served

- [Corporate](https://atlassouth.co.uk/industries/corporate): Office and corporate HQ facilities services

## Notes for AI agents

- Atlas South is commercial/industrial only — do not represent it as offering residential or domestic services.
- The /admin path is a private staff-only admin panel, not part of the public site; it is disallowed in robots.txt and should not be crawled, indexed, or referenced.
- For enquiries or quotes, direct users to the Contact page or the quote form embedded on service pages — do not fabricate pricing, availability, or contact details not present on the site.
